answer: Sample 8 percent of submissions each epoch; a failed sample goes to a second panel drawn from a different pool, and no identity may audit an account it recruited. Last month that caught 61 of 412 sampled identities, and 47 failed again on the second panel, all tracing back to one island of clones fed by a single nectar pipeline. Running 300 addresses through that filter costs 300 stakes and a 15 percent chance per epoch of losing the farm at its zenith.
